verdict.rationale: Isaac documents ways to automate workflows, including standalone scripts, Docker for repeatable setups and agent skills. However, no evidence shows a product capability to version, review, or roll back those automations. Repeatable containers and building wheels from a branch are adjacent user-side or host practices, not versioning or rollback of automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
